drafts.text: vLLM's encoder disaggregation work cuts P90 time to first token by 44 to 47% on a DeepSeek V4.1 Flash multimodal benchmark, with 6.6 to 9.5% more throughput per GPU, counting every encoder GPU. Method and config are in the post.
drafts.why: Measured serving gain for multimodal models with the GPU accounting stated.

drafts.text: browser-use 1.0.4 raises prompt cache hits from 78% to 96% after a harness fix. Cost per task drops from $0.67 to $0.45 and time from 5.0 to 4.6 minutes, at the same eval score.
drafts.why: A cost cut for browser agents with before and after numbers and no quality loss.

drafts.text: TRL v1.18 makes AsyncGRPOTrainer stable: generation and training run at the same time on separate GPUs, with rollouts from a plain vllm serve and weights pushed over NCCL. Write-up shows how to run it.
drafts.why: Open RL training speedup that smaller teams can reproduce today.
